newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks remain calm.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks remain calm.

text.p: Stocks remained calm in after-hours trading with Novell Inc halted in anticipation of the release of its quarterly earnings, dealers said Wednesday.
Novell later reported a second quarter loss of $0.04 a share against a loss of $0.15 for the same period last year.
First Call's consensus among industry analysts had forecast a profit of $0.03 for the quarter.
The network software company also said it will cut its workforce by about 1,000 employees, or 18 percent, and expects a third quarter operating loss.
The Nasdaq Stock Market later resumed trading in Novell, which led to its stock to edge slightly lower to 7 from 8-1/16 at the close, according to another trader.
The New York Stock Exchange said Wednesday that session one had a volume of 6,600 shares against 229,600 the previous day. Session two had 148,300 against nothing on Tuesday, it added.
